completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "In these excerpts, the accidents typically involved weather conditions conducive to serious carburetor icing, such as the temperature and dew point ranges on the icing probability chart, at cruise or glide power [20220407104901:analysis][20190907X64846:factual][20221222106486:factual][20240104193608:factual].
